name: powerbi
description: Power BI integration via the Power BI REST API — list workspaces, datasets, reports, and dashboards, run DAX queries against datasets, trigger dataset refreshes, and inspect refresh history. Uses app-only (OAuth2 client-credentials) auth with a Microsoft Entra service principal; the service principal must be allowed to call Fabric public APIs (tenant setting) and be a Member or Admin of each target workspace.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Power BI workspaces, datasets, reports, and refreshes via the Power BI REST API (service principal)

fields.label: Directory (Tenant) ID
fields.helpText: The Microsoft Entra tenant ID (GUID) of your organization.

fields.label: Application (Client) ID
fields.helpText: The Application (client) ID of the Entra app registration. Do not add Power BI API permissions to the app — they are unused for service principals and cause errors.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.helpText: A client secret for the app registration. A Fabric admin must enable the tenant setting 'Service principals can call Fabric public APIs' for this to work.

tools.name: powerbi.list_workspaces
tools.description: List the Power BI workspaces (groups) the service principal has access to, with id, name, and whether each is on dedicated capacity.

tools.name: powerbi.list_datasets
tools.description: List the datasets (semantic models) in a workspace, with id, name, owner, and whether each is refreshable.

tools.name: powerbi.list_reports
tools.description: List the reports in a workspace, with id, name, web URL, and the dataset each report is bound to.

tools.name: powerbi.list_dashboards
tools.description: List the dashboards in a workspace (id and display name). If dashboardId is given, list that dashboard's tiles instead (id, title, and linked report/dataset).

dashboardId.description: Optional dashboard ID (GUID); when given, returns the dashboard's tiles instead of the dashboard list

tools.name: powerbi.execute_dax
tools.description: Run a single DAX query against a dataset via the Execute Queries REST API and return the first result table's rows (capped by maxRows, with a truncation flag). API limits: one query per call, at most 100,000 rows / 15 MB per query result. Not available for RLS/SSO-enabled datasets when using a service principal.

query.description: The DAX query to execute, e.g. EVALUATE TOPN(10, 'Sales')

maxRows.description: Max rows to return from the first result table (default 100, max 1000)

tools.name: powerbi.get_refresh_history
tools.description: Get the refresh history of a dataset — status, start/end time, and a trimmed service exception for failed refreshes.

limit.description: Max refresh entries to return (default 10, max 100)

tools.name: powerbi.refresh_dataset
tools.description: Trigger an asynchronous refresh of a dataset. On shared capacity a dataset is limited to 8 API/scheduled refreshes per day; the refresh runs in the background — check progress with powerbi.get_refresh_history.
